name: GOV base: Upgraded
description: EIP-1967 proxies (OZ Transparent/UUPS/ERC1967Proxy, Aave InitializableImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy): Upgraded(address) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity critical. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the new holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
